trap.label: verbo + infinitivo
trap.wrong: I decided going to the meeting.
trap.right: I decided to go to the meeting.
trap.why: Em português “decidi ir” é um infinitivo; o brasileiro troca por -ing por analogia com outros verbos. Decide, want, hope, promise pedem to + base.

opts: We want that the bridge opens.
We want the bridge to open.

fix.right: They decided to build a bridge.

fix.wrong: She promised to not be late.
fix.right: She promised not to be late.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “I hope. I see you.” (hope to)
Reescreva: “I want. You come.” (want you to)
